evidence.curator_note: GENERIC SCHEME, upper (all-single-bond) form of eq 8.44. The book braces the two drawn forms together as resonance depictions of ONE even-electron ion (EE+); this record encodes the upper form AB-C-D with the charge (+) on the saturated terminal atom D and a full arrow labelled 'i' to AB+ + C=D. No atoms, m/z or intensities are printed. Instantiation chosen by the curator: the ethyl oxocarbenium ion drawn in its localized carbenium resonance form CH3CH2-O-CH2+ (map 3 = C-of-scheme = O, neutral, single-bonded; map 4 = D = terminal CH2 carbenium carrying the +; AB = ethyl, maps 1-2). Inductive cleavage: the CH2-O sigma bond (bond 2-3) breaks and its pair forms the new C=D (O=CH2) pi bond (bond 3-4), expelling the ethyl cation CH3CH2+ (AB+, charge migrates from D to AB) and neutral formaldehyde O=CH2 (C=D). ARC COUNT: the book draws 1 arc (a single full/double-barbed arrow from the AB-C sigma bond onto the C-D bond); move <1> IS that drawn arc, a single 2-electron sigma->pi move that fully accounts for the electron flow. The companion lower form is encoded as IMS8-EQ8.44b.

No MØD rule is indexed for eq 8.44 (rule_index.json by_equation has no '8.44' entry); no cross-link to verify, no rule_mismatch to report. VERIFIED RELATED RULE: IMS_8_10 (eq 8.10, src/data_generation/rules/IMS_chap8_examples.py) realizes exactly this net transformation for the same ethyl-oxocarbenium substrate. Its DFS [C]1(H3)[C]5(H2)[O+]8{=}[C]9(H2) >> [C]1(H3)[C+]5(H2).[O]8{=}[C]9(H2) cleaves the C5-O8 bond, puts +1 on the ethyl carbon C5 and leaves neutral O8=C9 formaldehyde -> ethyl+ + O=CH2, identical products to this record. IMS_8_10 is drawn from the O+=CH2 (oxocarbenium) resonance form, i.e. the 8.44b partner of this braced pair; it is indexed under eq 8.10, not 8.44.

m/z 29.0386 is the monoisotopic mass of the ethyl cation C2H5+ from the curator's chosen instantiation of the generic AB+ fragment; it is NOT printed on the page. Generic scheme with no printed m/z or intensity, hence status 'inferred', detected=false, no relative_intensity.
